vidit hominem quem ipse bonum creaverat, malum fu-
turum esse: & bonum quoque praevidit, quod sic etiam de
illo erat ipse facturus. Augustinus lib. 14. cap. 11.

eorum peccatum, id est, factum eorum, & manducatio-
nem fructus interdicti. R. Etsi & voluntas mala,
quam homines habuerunt, & factum ipsum ex Satana
suggestione fuit: tamen ut ad malum opus perveniretur,
praecessit hominum mala voluntas opus ipsum (seu esum

page.notes: Some words in the first lines are heavily worn; "pertypbatu" reads as printed but is uncertain. The line "1 3" at the foot is a printed signature/number and is recorded under signature. Several letters in the text are blurred, so doubtful readings may be imperfect.
